author: Lesson, 1831
summary: 열대 바다에 사는 땅딸막한 바닷새이다. 사람 사는 곳 가까이에 둥지를 틀고, 엷은 푸른빛이 도는 백악질 알을 2개 낳는다. 바하마와 대서양, 인도양, 태평양의 섬 등지에 분포한다.

art.subject: Masked Booby (Sula dactylatra), adult: head, neck, body and wing coverts white; all flight feathers and the tertials blackish-brown, forming a black trailing half to the wing; tail black; bare skin around the bill base, face and throat black, forming a dark mask. Bill stout and yellow (bright yellow in males, duller greenish-yellow in females); iris yellow; legs and feet dark olive-grey.
art.pose: standing on a rocky island ledge, side view
art.scene: tropical sea around a small rocky island; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing: white body, black mask of bare skin around the face, stout yellow bill, yellow eye, black flight feathers and tertials folded along the side, black wedge-shaped tail, dark olive-grey feet
adult, flight seen from below: white body and underwing coverts, black trailing edge running the full length of the wing and black wingtips, black pointed tail, yellow bill and black face mask
art.build: Largest booby, about 81cm, a large, heavy, cigar-shaped seabird bigger than a Black-tailed Gull, with a thick neck and conical head. Bill about as long as the head, stout and conical, tapering to a sharp point, with no visible nostrils. Legs short, feet large and webbed. In flight long, pointed wings, white with a broad black trailing edge along their whole length and black tips; tail pointed, wedge-shaped and black. Plunge-dives from the air for fish.
avoid: Do not paint a pink, orange or blue bill; the adult bill is yellow (an orange-pink bill belongs to Nazca Booby, Sula granti).
Do not paint red or blue feet; the feet are dark olive-grey.
Do not give it a white tail; the tail is black (white-morph Red-footed Booby has a white tail).
Do not restrict the black to the wingtips; all the flight feathers are black, forming a black trailing half to the wing.
